steps.content: A vast expanse of white stretches out before her, as if she's lying in the snow.
Kelvin thinks this to herself.
After all, the temperature feels like lying in the snow, too.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Snow?!
Bright white light shines into her eyes. Kelvin suddenly comes back to her senses.
She pants and squints, adjusting to the light.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Something's wrong! What... What is this place?!
Kelvin looks around in panic, and spots Macchiato looking back at her from a similar transparent box!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: M-Miss Macchiato! You're all right!!
Kelvin feels tears welling in her eyes. She quickly pulls out the tubes in her hands and feet, then pushes open the lid with all her might.
After finding her balance, she hugs Macchiato in a tight embrace.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Miss Macchiato... Ch-Chief! Quick, let's find Chief!
Holding onto one another, Kelvin and Macchiato look around, but there's no one else here except them.
This doesn't seem like the floor where Kelvin was eliminated. Though there's a big mess around them, the dining table at the center is exquisite and ornate.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: This must be Level B2...! Did Chief make it down here successfully?!

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I can sense Chief! Quick, let's go find him!
steps.female_content: I can sense Chief! Quick, let's go find her!

steps.content: The elevator is back in service. The pair walks in carefully and presses the button for the top floor.
When the elevator reaches Level B1, it grinds to a halt.
When the door opens, a lavishly dressed but exhausted-looking guest shuffles in, followed by several equally tired-looking guests.

steps.speaker: Lavishly-dressed Guest
steps.content: What are you looking at? Never seen a man dressed like this before?
His voice is hoarse, as if he had been crying.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: S-sorry! It's just that... y-you look really good in that dress, so I couldn't help but look...

steps.speaker: Lavishly-dressed Guest
steps.content: Ah... I-I see...

steps.speaker: Lavishly-dressed Guest
steps.content: Thank you...

steps.speaker: Guest with notebook
steps.content: I'm too tired... I don't want to write anything right now. I just wanna go home and sleep to my heart's content.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: This place is so scary... I want to go back to my hometown... and hang out with my old friends...

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content: Hey... Hubby... sob... You said I'm perfect the way I am, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content: Sob... I know, I think I get it now... sob... I think so, too!
The elevator finally comes to the first floor. Everyone is relieved to see the long-lost sunshine.
Sheriffs from the Eastside Public Security Bureau have already arrived. They are maintaining order at the scene and helping the injured...
Though not many people are seriously hurt on this floor...

steps.speaker: Tanned Boxer
steps.content: Sob... Miss Macchiato...! That scared me to death...! Sob...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: There, there. You're a big boy. Don't cry like that...

steps.speaker: Tanned Boxer
steps.content: So what if I'm a big boy? Can't boys cry?! Sob...

steps.speaker: Stylish Girl
steps.content: Why can't there be pineapples on pizza?

steps.speaker: Stylish Girl
steps.content: I can eat whatever I like! Who are you to tell me how should I eat?! It's not like you're the one eating it! I'll do as I please!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: All right, all right, you do as you please. But miss, you've already eaten three big slices of pineapple pizza after you woke up... Don't you feel bloated?

steps.speaker: Stylish Girl
steps.content: I'll do as I please!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: All right, all right...
Seeing that everyone seems safe and sound, Kelvin and Macchiato continue onwards, feeling relieved.
At the front gate, the person they've been worrying about finally appears.

steps.speaker: Kelvin & Macchiato
steps.content: Chief!!!
Upon hearing their call, Chief turns around and waves to them with a smile.
The two rush forward and hug Chief tightly, as if embracing a long-lost treasure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There there, everything's fine now...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You guys did really, really well...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Thanks, Chief...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Mmm, thank you, Chief...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: But why did that FAC vehicle leave already?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I think I saw someone familiar in there...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah... you did. You'll meet again soon.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everything has been settled. Time to go home.
